description: TypeInterner keeps every Descr in both arena and index (HashMap<Descr, Ty>). Keep one copy: the index maps a descriptor's hash to arena positions and compares against the arena. The spike hashed with DefaultHasher directly; in the build use the crate's one hasher choice so the hasher ticket covers it. Built together with the activation-identity change in the spike (-1.2% to -1.8% for both); measure this one alone. Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/compile-cost-round-two.html (https://claude.ai/artifact/4T5Lime7pQxKbCiKJqaJ8x). Spike (base c768670cd; port by reading, not by applying): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/tables/stepD.diff. Acceptance: stdout (interp and run), canonical dump, activation key counts and job counts identical to the base binary on /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/p/distinct1.fz, f761.fz (--top 1 --top 2), f765.fz (--max-top 3), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/m/r6.fz, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/b3126377-4731-4b0b-825a-a57f770f6d53/scratchpad/l/lit16.fz; release instructions retired re-measured on base and change binaries built the same way; full gate.
